instruction: Scale the image to 1920 by 1080 pixels.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully converted image to Indexed (Palette-Based) color mode in GIMP by navigating Image > Mode > Indexed, configuring the Indexed Color Conversion dialog with 256 colors and optimum palette, and clicking Convert. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus (Image menu), interact with dialog boxes, handle color profile conversion prompts, convert between image color modes
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a different Image menu operation (Scale Image) which requires similar menu navigation skills but involves a different dialog (scale dimensions) that the model should be able to handle based on demonstrated GIMP menu navigation capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires scaling the image to specific dimensions via Image > Scale Image. Postconfig exports the scaled image as PNG. Evaluator uses official check_image_size metric to verify the exported image has width=1920 and height=1080.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires scaling to 1920x1080 pixels; evaluator checks exactly width=1920 and height=1080 — complete coverage of the single requirement.
check_image_size metric correctly receives the rules dict directly (width, height) when expected.type='rule', and uses rule.get('width') and rule.get('height') — correct parameter handling.
Postconfig uses Shift+Ctrl+E (GIMP Export As) to export the scaled image before the getter retrieves it — correct state flow ensuring file exists at evaluation time.
vm_file getter retrieves the exported file from /home/user/Desktop/resized_computer.png — matches the expected export location.
Metric opens image with PIL, reads img.size (width, height), and performs exact integer comparison — semantically appropriate for verifying pixel dimensions.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The postconfig types 'resized_computer' without .png extension. GIMP's Export As dialog may or may not auto-append the extension depending on the file type selector state. Consider typing 'resized_computer.png' explicitly to ensure the exported file matches the getter path.
